# role: # A PR may only be reviewed by a row whose tier is strictly greater than the
# tier that built it. That keeps a model from clearing its own work while
# still letting one provider fill both roles at different effort levels.
# Orca's worker-start --model/--effort covers Claude, Codex and Cursor only.
# Antigravity's model is declared here but configured on its own side; Orca
# Every `agent` below must be an agent CONFIGURED IN ORCA, not merely a binary
# on PATH. `worker-start --agent <id>` validates against Orca's configured
# agents and rejects anything else with `agent_unconfigured`, which costs a
# claim every scheduled run. tests/pool/test_roster.sh enforces this.
# Tier 1 takes the mechanical, well-specified issues. Tier 2 takes the ones
# whose difficulty is algorithmic rather than large: AI steering, simulation
# budgets, physics integration, device profiling. Routing is by `agent:<id>`
# label on the issue; unlabelled issues fall to the lowest tier.
